title: REINFORCE with a baseline

paper.title: Simple statistical gradient-following algorithms for connectionist reinforcement learning
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement REINFORCE with a baseline: estimate CartPole policy gradients with reward-to-go and a learned value baseline. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use cartpole; required output: Observation -> action logits plus baseline. Evaluate episode_return (maximize). Detach advantage from policy gradient; no evaluation-episode training. Required ablation: Remove the baseline and compare gradient variance across seeds. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
